{"code": "print('''To change the website title to just your name (Shubham Singh), you need to modify the following files in your Create React App project:

1. **src/index.js** - Update the document title:
```javascript
import React from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client';
import './index.css';
import App from './App';

const root = ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root'));
root.render(
  <React.StrictMode>
    <App />
  </React.StrictMode>
);

// ADD THIS LINE:
document.title = 'Shubham Singh';
```

2. **public/index.html** - Update the `<title>` tag:
```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang=\"en\">
  <head>
    <meta charset=\"utf-8\" />
    <link rel=\"icon\" href=\"%PUBLIC_URL%/favicon.ico\" />
    <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\" />
    <!-- CHANGE THIS LINE: -->
    <title>Shubham Singh</title>
    <!-- rest of head content -->
  </head>
  <body>
    <!-- ... -->
  </body>
</html>
```

3. **src/components/SEO.js** - Update any title settings in this component (it likely manages dynamic titles):
```javascript
// Look for useEffect that sets document.title and change it to:
document.title = 'Shubham Singh';
```

4. **public/manifest.json** - Update the app name:
```json
{
  \"short_name\": \"Shubham Singh\",
  \"name\": \"Shubham Singh - Quantitative Researcher\",
  // ...
}
```

**Quickest fix**: Just edit `public/index.html` title tag to `<title>Shubham Singh</title>` and run `npm start` to see the change immedia
